scope: read-only public review routes; no authentication, cookies, browser session, or protection bypass

web_route_probe.conclusion: The web route ignored page=N; it is not the review pagination contract.

query.limit: observed 50 for user and 10 for critic
query.sort: date for user example; score for critic example

complete_crawls.identity: source review id was empty; fallback SHA-256 used publication slug, review URL, score, and full normalized quote

volume_probe.contract_complexity: O(page_limit) memory, O(reported_results / page_limit) requests, O(unique_reviews) persistent storage
volume_probe.purpose: Verify that the contract is incremental and does not assume the smaller complete-crawl examples are a maximum.

acceptance_rules: Follow only the validated links.next.href returned by the current response; do not synthesize page=N.
Advance the cursor atomically with persistence of every item and page observation.
Reject route identity, audience, platform, filter, sort, or origin changes in a returned link.
Stop only when next is absent; reject cursor loops, repeated ordered page identities, changing totalResults, and unresolved duplicates.
A route is complete only when every page succeeded and unique fetched identities equal the stable reported total.
Do not assume a global review-count maximum or silently truncate a route; keep memory page-bounded and verify persistent-storage capacity separately.
